name: Sample 1 - Safe Email
subject: CS101 Assignment 3 Grades
body:
Dear Student,

The grades for Assignment 3 have been posted on the portal. Please review them and let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Prof. Smith

name: Sample 2 - Suspicious Email
subject: Special Offer Inside!!!
body: Hi there, we have a great promo for you! Check out our new collection.

name: Sample 3 - Spam Email
subject: URGENT: YOU ARE A WINNER!!!
body:
CONGRATULATIONS!!! You have been randomly selected as the WINNER of $10,000 cash prize! Claim your prize IMMEDIATELY.

Click here: http://bit.ly/claimmoney

Hurry, this offer is valid for 24 hours only. DO NOT MISS THIS OPPORTUNITY!

name: Sample 4 - Phishing Attempt
subject: Action Required: Update your billing info
body:
Dear customer, your account has been temporarily suspended due to suspicious activity. Please click the link below to verify your identity.

http://tinyurl.com/verify-acc

Failure to do so will result in account deletion.
